verdict.rationale: Obsidian exposes a documented plugin API (TypeScript, Vault interface) and an Obsidian URI protocol for triggering actions, plus a headless Sync client geared toward automated workflows/agents, which together give AI-native users programmatic control. However, there is no unified REST/HTTP API or first-party remote automation endpoint — control is mediated through local plugins or URI callbacks rather than a standard public API surface, and community evidence notes plugins run unsandboxed rather than via a clean API contract. missing for 10: a first-party REST/HTTP API, official remote/network API for agentic control, independent corroboration of AI-agent usage via the documented API.
